notes: The supplied pages show only the 8658 build (page 1, steps 1-9) and page 2, which is the combination model 8655+8658. The page 2 build needs 8655 parts that are not shown, so only the 8658 model is graphed.
The inventory pages with Element IDs were not supplied. Part types are best guesses from the catalogue based on the pictures, and the colours are approximate.

Small details are uncertain. These include which piece is the grille and headlight front piece, the exact exhaust and clip pieces, and the exact stud-to-stud connections of the 2x4 body and plates in steps 4-6.
The step 4 side studs on the body were omitted, and the body is modelled as a single 2x4 brick.
The black 2x2 plate and the grille and headlight piece in the step 6 parts box are modelled as attaching to the black plate and the red plate respectively, since the arrow position is ambiguous.
Step 9 shows the four large tires on gray hubs, which are fitted to the axles of the two wheel holders.
